all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
Isaiah 64:4
Quote of the Day
"Jesus Christ understands our challenges, having taken on not only our sins but also our griefs, sicknesses, and frailties."
Elder Dale G. Renlund | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
